name: claude-maths-tutor-voice
description: Build-time text-to-speech for Coach Ollie. Runs on the parent's Mac only. Deliberately NOT part of the app's own package.json: kokoro-js pulls in @huggingface/transformers and a native ONNX runtime (hundreds of MB) that must never reach the Netlify deploy or the child's iPad. See docs/voice.md.
